errors.text: The hypothesis concerns a bulk, particle-strengthened compositionally complex alloy rather than high-entropy nanoparticles, so it does not establish applicability to nanoalloy-specific segregation, coalescence, melting, or evaporation.
The cited abstract says Hf and Mo were investigated for optimization but does not report that their addition actually improved high-temperature strength or structural and chemical stability.
Tensile strength and SEM alone do not directly test chemical stability or nanoscale elemental segregation.
